$comment: Every secret a stack needs, with its owner. owner=module: an output another module writes back (never minted, not required before that module runs). owner=generated: bootstrap mints it with crypto.randomBytes and writes it to the stack's GitHub Environment; owner=operator: a root credential the human provides ONCE (bootstrap only verifies presence). Drift between this manifest and the GitHub Environment fails `bootstrap --verify` loudly.

secrets.name: NAS_POSTGRES_PASSWORD
secrets.rotation: on-demand (--rotate); rotating requires a coordinated db password change

secrets.name: NAS_PUSH_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.rotation: never casually — replacing the pair kills existing web-push subscriptions

secrets.name: NAS_PUSH_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.rotation: never casually — paired with the public key

secrets.name: NAS_LOGTO_M2M_APP_ID
secrets.rotation: written back by the logto module after app upsert

secrets.name: NAS_LOGTO_M2M_APP_SECRET
secrets.rotation: written back by the logto module after app upsert

secrets.name: IAC_LOGTO_INFRA_M2M_ID
secrets.rotation: the one manual Logto step: OOBE admin creates the 'infra' M2M app once per pair

secrets.name: NAS_ADMIN_SUBS
secrets.rotation: comma-separated OIDC subs allowed into the admin area

secrets.name: NAS_API_SENTRY_DSN
secrets.rotation: created in the pair's GlitchTip UI after first boot, then stored
